summary: Quantum Leap Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K announcing the commencement of separate trading of its Class A ordinary shares and warrants, previously part of its IPO units. The company consummated its IPO of 20 million units on May 4, 2026. Separate trading begins June 23, 2026 on NYSE under symbols QLEP and QLEP WS. Holders need not take action; no fractional warrants issued. This is a routine post-IPO structural update, not a special situation.
